label: Garland FieldTAP 10/100/1000M Aggregation TAP (P1GCUA_mini)
description: Garland FieldTAP P1GCUA_mini - pocket-sized passive aggregation TAP for field troubleshooting: two 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 network ports inline, copies aggregated out of a single USB 3.0 monitoring port (5 Gb/s), DIP-switch configured, passes PoE through, power supply included.
notes: The monitor port is the interesting absence: the copies leave through **USB 3.0** (5 Gb/s) into a laptop, which is not a network medium and cannot be an interface here. So this TAP has two RJ45 network ports and **no in-band monitor port** - a lab sees a pass-through pair, which is exactly what it is on the wire; the capture goes off-network. It also **passes PoE through**, so inserting it does not drop power to a downstream device - a detail no `poeIn`/`poeOut` field expresses, since the watts neither terminate nor originate here. DIP switches, no software: passive, no capabilities.
